events.title: Additions to the Entity List
events.summary: In this rule, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) by adding 7 entities to the Entity List, under the destinations of Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand. These entities have been determined by the U.S. Government to be acting contrary to the national security or foreign policy interests of the United States.

events.title: Commissioner Jørgensen in Ireland to advance work on energy and housing affordability
events.summary: On 25–26 November, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Dublin, Ireland, to exchange with national and local policymakers on ways to tackle two of the most urgent issues affecting European citizens and businesses: housing and energy affordability.

events.title: Commission publishes proposal for Joint  Employment  Report 2027 and pushes Recommendation on Human Capital
events.summary: The proposed Joint Employment Report says the labour market stays robust, but manufacturing jobs drop due to recent energy shocks. A Capital Recommendation urges the EU to close skills gaps in clean‑energy, defence, space and AI‑related STEM fields.

events.title: Representatives of European regions and local communities gather in Dublin to accelerate adaptation to climate change
events.summary: Fifth EU Mission Forum on Adaptation to Climate Change to highlight importance of proactively preparing for climate risks, protecting people, and keeping Europe’s economy productive and competitive.

events.summary: From climate research and urban planning to environmental education, Laboratório da Paisagem plays a key role in Guimarães’ journey as European Green Capital 2026. Explore how its work supports local sustainability and inspires collaboration beyond the city.

events.title: Publication of the Mind the Gap Communication
events.summary: The European Commission published the 2026 edition of Mind the Gap. Its objective is to support Member States in boosting public finances through joint efforts to reduce tax gaps, improve compliance, and strengthen revenue collection.

events.title: Commission launches European Skills Observatory to strengthen skills and fair transition analysis across the EU
events.summary: The European Skills Observatory is a new tool bringing together data and analysis on current and future skills needs, supply and shortages, job trends, and education and training across the EU.

events.title: Commission approves €1 billion Slovenian State aid to support closure of Premogovnik Velenje coal mine
events.summary: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €1 billion Slovenian measure to cover exceptional costs related to the closure of the Premogovnik Velenje coal mine. The aid will help Slovenia phase out coal by 2033 in line with its binding commitment under national law.

events.summary: At the 2026 Annual Meeting of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT) in Vilamoura, Portugal, ICCAT members, which include the European Union, reached a breakthrough agreement to strengthen action against shark finning in the Atlantic and Mediterranean.

events.title: Better protected for your next credit application
events.summary: With the entry into force of a new EU law on consumer credit on 20 November 2026, our level of protection when signing up for a credit agreement increases. Designed to strengthen our rights and help us make informed choices, the EU law now covers loans up to €100,000.

events.title: EU backs global compact to cut energy bills and emissions from buildings
events.summary: Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

events.title: Strategic Orientations 2027–2029 strengthen the radicalisation prevention
events.summary: On 20 November, the Steering Board on Prevention of Radicalisation endorsed the Strategic Orientations for 2027–2029. Aligned with the ProtectEU Agenda, the Strategic Orientations set a common framework to address evolving terrorist and extremist threats.

events.title: Gas Coordination Group confirms EU’s winter preparedness, importance of gas storage through the winter
events.summary: Despite challenging price conditions and continued geopolitical uncertainty, experts from the EU countries, the Commission and stakeholder associations confirmed once again today in the latest meeting of the Gas Coordination Group that the EU is prepared for winter.

events.title: Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors
events.summary: In this interim final rule (IFR), the Department of Commerce is establishing new rules to prevent certain foreign actors from leveraging advanced computing power based on U.S. technology to threaten U.S. national security and foreign policy interests. First, this rule establishes new restrictions which will apply for exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) to overseas data centers that remotely supply significant volumes of compute to companies headquartered in Country Group D:5 or Macau.
